mapper.sql: SELECT ra.id, ra.application_no, ra.user_id, ra.real_name, ra.id_card, ra.login_account, ra.position_id, ra.dept_id, ra.expected_entry_date, ra.status, ra.reject_reason, ra.audit_count, ra.create_time, ra.update_time, p.position_name, d.dept_name, u.status AS account_status, u.user_status, u.mentor_name, u.mentor_phone FROM register_application ra LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = ra.position_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = ra.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = ra.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: WHERE ra.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ra.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'WAIT_AUDIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected_count FROM register_application ra
ra.dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE register_application SET application_no = #{applicationNo}, user_id = #{userId}, real_name = #{realName}, id_card = #{idCard}, login_account = #{loginAccount}, position_id = #{positionId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, expected_entry_date = #{expectedEntryDate,jdbcType=DATE}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, audit_count = #{auditCount}, create_time = #{createTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
